f5ac1905-8293-53bb-b361-a62b1be2c4f8.title: Solar storms and sleep / HRV
f5ac1905-8293-53bb-b361-a62b1be2c4f8.prediction: With at least 30 days per person, the mean Spearman correlation between Kp exposure and outcome falls outside the circular-shift null (p ≤ 0.0125).
f5ac1905-8293-53bb-b361-a62b1be2c4f8.refuter: The statistic lands inside the circular null (act FB-014).
f5ac1905-8293-53bb-b361-a62b1be2c4f8.result: Refuted on real data: LifeSnaps wearables × GFZ Kp (FB-014).

f9af5667-837f-5a3f-a524-37a52bc8b748.title: Short sleep, tired next day
f9af5667-837f-5a3f-a524-37a52bc8b748.prediction: Days with sleep below the person's own median raise the probability of reporting tiredness by at least 3 percentage points versus that person's other days.
f9af5667-837f-5a3f-a524-37a52bc8b748.refuter: Within-person difference below 0.03, or p above 0.025 (act FB-016, card A).
f9af5667-837f-5a3f-a524-37a52bc8b748.mechanism: Sleep restriction leads to subjective fatigue.
f9af5667-837f-5a3f-a524-37a52bc8b748.result: Sustained: +7.9 points, 27 people, p = 0.001, with a positive control (FB-016 A).

ca55ac22-b987-5421-8e9c-e7178e6aeed2.title: Tension and lower HRV
ca55ac22-b987-5421-8e9c-e7178e6aeed2.prediction: Tense days show overnight rmssd at least 0.05 SD lower than the same person's non-tense days.
ca55ac22-b987-5421-8e9c-e7178e6aeed2.refuter: Difference no lower than −0.05 SD, or p above 0.025 (act FB-016, card B).
ca55ac22-b987-5421-8e9c-e7178e6aeed2.mechanism: Sympathetic activation goes with lower vagal variability.
ca55ac22-b987-5421-8e9c-e7178e6aeed2.result: Refuted on real LifeSnaps data (FB-016 B).

b4e8e1c3-6f3e-52da-b602-3709cf9b8894.title: Bone loss clogs the urine processor
b4e8e1c3-6f3e-52da-b602-3709cf9b8894.prediction: Across at least 8 missions, time to clogging falls as aggregate urinary calcium rises: rho ≤ −0.5.
b4e8e1c3-6f3e-52da-b602-3709cf9b8894.refuter: rho above −0.2 with n ≥ 8, or no dose–response (act FB-017).
b4e8e1c3-6f3e-52da-b602-3709cf9b8894.mechanism: Bone-loss hypercalciuria precipitates calcium sulfate in the urine processor's distillation assembly (Jones 2019).
b4e8e1c3-6f3e-52da-b602-3709cf9b8894.result: No data: public mission-level calcium doses do not exist yet. Not simulated.

e68d0bd9-c97b-5e17-82ef-516560d68d04.title: Whitening the pulse detector
e68d0bd9-c97b-5e17-82ef-516560d68d04.prediction: A whitened detector (frozen φ = 0.182) lowers pulse false alarms below the critical value in an independent cohort.
e68d0bd9-c97b-5e17-82ef-516560d68d04.refuter: x_pw at or above x_critical, or x_pw above x_base (act FB-013, H2).
e68d0bd9-c97b-5e17-82ef-516560d68d04.mechanism: Positive autocorrelation of daily pulse inflates CUSUM false alarms; AR(1) whitening would correct it.
e68d0bd9-c97b-5e17-82ef-516560d68d04.result: In test: the independent cohort could not settle it (FB-013). Recommendation: do not enable by default.

af2f9c04-37f4-579c-9609-845862b4d450.title: A personal band sees astronauts' blood change
af2f9c04-37f4-579c-9609-845862b4d450.prediction: On landing day, lymphocytes fall below each astronaut's own prediction band (built from three pre-flight draws) in at least 2 of 4 astronauts.
af2f9c04-37f4-579c-9609-845862b4d450.refuter: Fewer than 2 of 4 leave the band (act FB-024, H2).
af2f9c04-37f4-579c-9609-845862b4d450.mechanism: Immune stress response on return from flight (lymphocyte redistribution).
af2f9c04-37f4-579c-9609-845862b4d450.result: Refuted on real astronaut data (NASA OSDR, Inspiration4): 0 of 4, despite a median fall of 24% — the band built from 3 samples is too wide to see it (FB-024).

acd51244-9f2e-54b2-9539-ab33e68f48ea.title: Borrowing the group's variation narrows the band
acd51244-9f2e-54b2-9539-ab33e68f48ea.prediction: On landing day, lymphocytes fall below the pooled band (variation shared across the four astronauts) in at least 2 of 4.
acd51244-9f2e-54b2-9539-ab33e68f48ea.refuter: Fewer than 2 of 4 leave the pooled band (act FB-025, H1).
acd51244-9f2e-54b2-9539-ab33e68f48ea.mechanism: Pooling within-person variation gives more degrees of freedom (t = 2.36 instead of 4.30) and a tighter band (exploratory: same data as FB-024).
acd51244-9f2e-54b2-9539-ab33e68f48ea.result: Refuted on real astronaut data: 0 of 4. Bands narrow by about 30%, but the detection floor stays near ±70% of the person's mean — day-to-day variation is huge (FB-025).

e593f7af-05e3-5992-a404-a552af5a56d3.title: Warmer nights, faster resting pulse
e593f7af-05e3-5992-a404-a552af5a56d3.prediction: Within each person, on held-out days, nightly skin temperature and resting pulse rise together (median rank correlation ≥ 0.20, ≥ 65% of people positive).
e593f7af-05e3-5992-a404-a552af5a56d3.refuter: Median below 0.20 or fewer than 65% positive (act FB-022, H1).
e593f7af-05e3-5992-a404-a552af5a56d3.mechanism: Thermoregulation: a warmer night raises resting heart rate.
e593f7af-05e3-5992-a404-a552af5a56d3.result: Sustained on real wearable data: median ρ = +0.24, 72% of 47 people positive (FB-022). Real coupling, modest size.

d835780f-d561-538a-8bd3-0e21d51bd133.title: Faster breathing, faster pulse
d835780f-d561-538a-8bd3-0e21d51bd133.prediction: Within each person, on held-out days, nightly breathing rate and resting pulse rise together (median rank correlation ≥ 0.20, ≥ 65% positive).
d835780f-d561-538a-8bd3-0e21d51bd133.refuter: Median below 0.20 or fewer than 65% positive (act FB-022, H3).
d835780f-d561-538a-8bd3-0e21d51bd133.result: Sustained on real wearable data: median ρ = +0.27, 79% of 33 people positive (FB-022).

0b443fed-9e59-55ac-9477-0c7f39ad1774.title: Short sleep, faster resting pulse
0b443fed-9e59-55ac-9477-0c7f39ad1774.prediction: Within each person, days with sleep below their own median have a resting pulse at least 0.5 bpm higher.
0b443fed-9e59-55ac-9477-0c7f39ad1774.refuter: Effect under 0.5 bpm or p > 0.0167; the placebo (labels shifted 40 days) must be null (act FB-026).
0b443fed-9e59-55ac-9477-0c7f39ad1774.result: Refuted by the sealed rule: the effect is real (+0.25 bpm, p = 0.003) but half the minimum we fixed before looking. Written by the lab's generator (FB-026).

c7fc6940-5bec-5d3b-a8ac-5f5bcc318110.title: Short sleep, lower overnight HRV
c7fc6940-5bec-5d3b-a8ac-5f5bcc318110.prediction: Within each person, days with sleep below their own median have overnight heart-rate variability at least 0.05 sd lower.
c7fc6940-5bec-5d3b-a8ac-5f5bcc318110.refuter: Effect smaller than 0.05 sd or p > 0.0167; the placebo must be null (act FB-026).
c7fc6940-5bec-5d3b-a8ac-5f5bcc318110.result: Sustained on real wearable data: −0.21 sd (p = 0.0001, 36 people); the placebo sees nothing. The lab's first clean result, written by its own generator (FB-026).

c41b2cb6-f787-52a8-adbf-cd27d9c2c71a.title: A hard day, a quieter night
c41b2cb6-f787-52a8-adbf-cd27d9c2c71a.prediction: Within each person, days with intense activity above their own median have overnight heart-rate variability at least 0.05 sd lower.
c41b2cb6-f787-52a8-adbf-cd27d9c2c71a.refuter: Effect smaller than 0.05 sd or p > 0.0167 (act FB-026).
c41b2cb6-f787-52a8-adbf-cd27d9c2c71a.mechanism: Heavy training load lowers vagal activity that night.
c41b2cb6-f787-52a8-adbf-cd27d9c2c71a.result: Refuted: no effect (+0.03 sd, p = 0.72). The effect may act on the next night, which a same-row pairing cannot see. Written by the generator (FB-026).

bd59d0af-1d37-50a1-9352-04a62d1d32f5.title: Warmer nights, worse sleep efficiency
bd59d0af-1d37-50a1-9352-04a62d1d32f5.prediction: Within each person, a warmer wrist at night goes with a lower sleep efficiency (median rank correlation ≤ −0.10).
bd59d0af-1d37-50a1-9352-04a62d1d32f5.refuter: Correlation not at least −0.10 or p > 0.0125 on held-out days (act FB-027).
bd59d0af-1d37-50a1-9352-04a62d1d32f5.result: Refuted — and the sign was the opposite: warmer nights went with BETTER efficiency (ρ = +0.11, p = 0.0015). A lead, not a result: confirming it needs another cohort with skin temperature.

d51a5d88-0554-5f0e-887f-c32b9253956d.title: Stress score, worse sleep efficiency
d51a5d88-0554-5f0e-887f-c32b9253956d.prediction: Within each person, a higher stress score goes with a lower sleep efficiency (median rank correlation ≤ −0.10).
d51a5d88-0554-5f0e-887f-c32b9253956d.refuter: Correlation not at least −0.10 or p > 0.0125 on held-out days (act FB-027).
d51a5d88-0554-5f0e-887f-c32b9253956d.result: Refuted with the opposite sign (ρ = +0.19). We sealed it without checking which way the score runs (higher = fewer signs of stress, per Fitbit) — and the score is partly built from sleep.

46e1545e-fb49-5d87-8a7c-070e503982ea.title: Geomagnetic activity, breathing rate
46e1545e-fb49-5d87-8a7c-070e503982ea.prediction: Within each person, the day's peak Kp goes with a change in nightly breathing rate (|median rank correlation| ≥ 0.10).
46e1545e-fb49-5d87-8a7c-070e503982ea.refuter: |S| below 0.10 or p > 0.0125 against the circular-shift null (act FB-027).
46e1545e-fb49-5d87-8a7c-070e503982ea.result: Refuted: nothing (ρ = −0.01, p = 0.74, 33 people). Consistent with the earlier Kp test.

a7610b8a-7938-5ebc-9784-8fb1d32444a0.title: A hard day, a quieter NEXT night
a7610b8a-7938-5ebc-9784-8fb1d32444a0.prediction: Within each person, days with intense activity above their own median are followed by overnight HRV at least 0.05 sd lower.
a7610b8a-7938-5ebc-9784-8fb1d32444a0.refuter: Effect smaller than 0.05 sd or p > 0.0125 (act FB-027).
a7610b8a-7938-5ebc-9784-8fb1d32444a0.mechanism: Recovery: heavy load lowers vagal tone the next night.
a7610b8a-7938-5ebc-9784-8fb1d32444a0.result: Refuted by the correction we fixed in advance: the effect has the size we expected (−0.08 sd) but p = 0.029. Suggestive, not conclusive.

umbral_personal.title: Short-sleep context alarm
umbral_personal.rule: A night with less sleep than the person's own baseline median.
umbral_personal.limit: It flags about half of all nights: a context alarm, never a critical one.

F-001.statement: NASA's open data repository (OSDR) will publish at least one data file for experiment OS-892 before 2027-12-31.
F-001.grading: True if the official API lists at least one file by that date; false if it still lists none on 2028-01-01.

F-002.statement: NOAA's geomagnetic-storm watch of 15 Nov 2026 13:34 UTC (message A20F: a G1 storm expected on 17 and 18 November) will come true: the planetary Kp index reaches 5 or more in some 3-hour reading between 17 Nov 00:00 and 19 Nov 00:00 UTC.
F-002.grading: True if NOAA's planetary K-index feed shows any reading in that window with Kp ≥ 5; false otherwise. Probability: our own estimate, no model.
